{{Short description|Regular pattern for geometric tiling}}
{{Uniform hyperbolic tiles db|Uniform hyperbolic tiling stat table|U77_01}}
In [[geometry]], the '''truncated order-7 heptagonal tiling''' is a uniform tiling of the [[Hyperbolic geometry|hyperbolic plane]]. It has [[Schläfli symbol]] of t<sub>0,1</sub>{7,7}, constructed from one heptagons and two tetrakaidecagons around every vertex.
